limitations: Internal review is not an external audit.
Source timestamps and executions are historical assumptions; original bar receipt timing, live fee tier and real executable depth are unavailable.
Forecast labels are price log returns; dividends are reconciled separately in economic cashflows.
Six hypotheses recipes use globally examined history and no independent prospective holdout.
The accounting auditor does not independently reprice each modeled fill or rerun the complete strategy.

review_findings.finding: Inherited residual-reversal protocol hypothesis, rank, budget and timestamp conflicted with new positive-continuation implementation.
review_findings.resolution: Protocol/recipes now identify H1/H2/H3 and six candidates, twelve scenario measurements, source protocol and already-seen history.

review_findings.finding: Feature ATR/volatility lookback needed protection for own-stock splits across the whole feature window.
review_findings.resolution: Own-stock split windows are refused for features and labels; no announcement time fabricated.

review_findings.finding: Removing a largest winner could accidentally remove a loss in all-loss samples.
review_findings.resolution: Diagnostic subtracts max(0, observed trade gains).

review_findings.finding: Auditor checked hard72h but did not verify shorter candidate or original H3 calendar deadlines.
review_findings.resolution: Independent calendar reconstruction checks horizon24/48/72, holding clock, deadline and H3 original deadline.

review_findings.finding: Calendar overhead attribution and independent-auditor scope needed precise labels.
review_findings.resolution: Reports label calendar-date costs; auditor explicitly relies on modeled replay fill prices/marks while reconciling inventory, reservations, fees, dividends, cash and equity.

scope: Causal forecast availability, purged TRAIN-only predictive guard, immutable calendar deadlines, paired H3 attribution, costs/cashflow accounting, source bindings and six-recipe limit.

tests_independently_run.command: PYTHONPATH=quant OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B -m unittest quant.tests.test_roadmap9_research

verified_design_properties: Each training label known_at <= model asof; calibration fit additionally purges labels beyond calibration cut.
Forecast components fit identical designs and sum to total; total HAC preserves dependence.
H3 uses only forecasts whose deadline <= original campaign deadline; missing forecast abstains.
H3 paired campaigns fix initial entry time, price and quantity; portfolios separately report capital reuse.
Controls share scenario costs, continuous capital and ex ante caps; realized exposures are not asserted risk matched.
Registry reserves all six candidates/two scenarios before financial measurement; code and data bindings checked through replay.
